title: Industry leaders join Tenaris for technical panels at ROG.e 2026
summary: Tenaris will host a series of technical and industry-focused panel discussions at ROG.e 2026 (Rio Oil & Gas Expo and Conference), one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

PUBLISHED ON 09/17/2026


Tenaris will host a series of technical and industry-focused panel discussions at ROG.e 2026 (Rio Oil & Gas Expo and Conference), one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The sessions will run at the company's booth (Pavilion 4, V26) from September 21 to 24 and will bring together experts from across the energy sector to share insights on talent development, drilling efficiency, and innovative solutions for offshore operations.


The program will feature representatives from Tenaris, Equinor, Brava Energia, UnIBP and Instituto Ternium, highlighting collaboration across industry, academia and professional organizations.


**Technical education and the future workforce**


September 21, 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.


The first panel will explore the role of technical education in preparing professionals for increasingly advanced, safe and sustainable industrial environments. Participants will discuss how educational institutions, industry organizations and companies can work together to develop the next generation of talent.


Speakers:


- **Luiz Marcondes** , Human Resources Director, Tenaris (moderator)
- **Karen Cubas** , Manager, UnIBP
- **Fernanda Candeias** , Institutional Affairs and Community Relations Direction at Ternium, and President of Instituto Ternium


**Driving efficiency in well construction**


September 22, 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.


A panel featuring specialists from Tenaris and BRAVA Energia will examine how integrated well construction solutions, including CaDIS™, casing drilling integrated services, contributed to operational efficiency and value creation in onshore drilling operations.


Speakers:


- **Joel Marim** , OCTG Commercial Director, Tenaris (moderator)
- **Juan Dario Santander Salazar** , Onshore Wells Manager, Brava Energia
- **Lucas Gonçalves** , Technical Sales Engineer, Tenaris


**Raia pipeline: Enabling a pioneering ultra-deepwater project through innovative solutions**


September 23, 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.


The third session will focus on the Raia gas pipeline project and the technologies that support operations in ultra-deepwater environments. Experts from Equinor and Tenaris will discuss the technical challenges involved and the solutions developed to help advance one of the industry's most ambitious offshore developments.


Speakers:


- **Vinicius Santos** , Senior Commercial Director, Tenaris (moderator)
- **Pedro Veronesi** , Senior Gas Export Facilities Manager, Raia Project, Equinor
- **Fabio Arroyo** , Product Director, Tenaris


Visit us at ROG.e 2026, **Pavilion 4, booth V26** , at Riocentro in Rio de Janeiro, from September 21 to 24, 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.


For more information about Tenaris, please follow us on ****[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/TenarisEvents) **,**[X](https://twitter.com/Tenaris) **,**[LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/tenaris) **,** and ****[Instagram](https://instagram.com/tenaris) **.**
